title: Giants agree on one-year deal with WR/KR Gunner Olszewski: report

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants agree on one-year deal with WR/KR Gunner Olszewski: report
sources.description: The Giants and wide receiver/kick returner Gunner Olszewski have reportedly agreed on a one-year contract to bring him back for the 2026 season.
